hooks.command:
cat << 'EOF'

🚀 Evolution Workflow Reminder
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When implementing a new feature, follow this order:

1️⃣  Review FEATURES.md (existing feature?)
2️⃣  Plan in PLANS.md (phases, sprints, versioning)
3️⃣  Check SPECS.md (update if needed)
4️⃣  Implement Code (follow PLANS.md sprints)
5️⃣  Update PLANS.md (mark sprints complete)
6️⃣  Update README.md (keep docs in sync)
7️⃣  Deploy (npm run deploy)

See CLAUDE.md v2.0 for detailed workflow.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

EOF

if [[ $(jq -r '.tool_input.command' 2>/dev/null) == *"git commit"* ]]; then
  if ! git show --name-only --pretty=format: | grep -q PLANS.md; then
    echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  Did you update PLANS.md to mark this sprint as complete?"}';
  fi
fi || true

hooks.prompt:
The user just submitted a prompt. If they mentioned: 'finished', 'done', 'completed', 'deploy', 'release', or implementation-related keywords, suggest:

✅ Did you:
- Update PLANS.md to mark sprints as complete?
- Update README.md with new features?
- Run 'npm run deploy'?

Respond briefly with any missing steps, or say 'All good!' if task description implies nothing's missing.
